title: Text: DET Dan Griesbaum ↔ Anthony Fenech

content.text: Sorry I haven’t gotten back to you, been busy here..have you heard how long Al’s extension was for?
No problem. I never heard. It was pretty quiet and CI never talks to anyone. Since Mr I died, that organization hasn’t been addressed as a group by either the owner, or Granger. Not even once.
Ok...the Tigers as a whole you mean

Right. When DD was President we had quarterly luncheons where he updated the entire office on things, answered baseball questions, etc. Granger has never talked to the group even one time. He wasn’t even introduced to the group by CI when he hired him. He just operates like the wizard of oz. I don’t even think the Lions would be that dysfunctional

What I was wondering about is DeAndre Berry. It appears he left the Dec. 31 after the clubhouse kid was told he wasn’t getting an internship. I just found it interesting, as if he were  to say F this, I know what’s going on here and I’m not gonna be a part of it

No I didn’t get a sense for that being the reason. I think he moved right into a better job that paid a lot more. Corey Bell is doing that job temporarily right now and they won’t make it permanent because I think they want to eliminate it. Like all Tigers positions, they want to have someone at LCA oversee it now so DeAndre probably just saw that coming and didn’t want to report to someone at LCA. Plus, like I said, he got a better job
